_about: The words of the header and the opening figure. Every number in both comes from idea-counts.json (node assets/src/count.ts, every command and its output in idea-counts.txt), rounded to 100 in the figure code so the parts add up to the whole.

header.line: Research for Claude: who would want it, how many, where, and every breakdown.

context: One choice on a sign-up page, counted for adults in the UK
choice: “You can only sign up in our app, on a smartphone.”

groups.who: go online, but not on a smartphone

note: Each square is 1 in 100 adults in the UK. It suits the people who go online on a smartphone. Counted on 200,000 made-up adults that match official statistics.
